sources.excerpt: Published on July 31, 2011 VFE Pedals fuzz pedal Controls fuzz filter bias level tr1 (toggle) tr2 (toggle) Information VFE Pedals This pedal takes the classic Fuzz Face circuit & allows you to swap in germanium or silicon transistors to create your own signature fuzz tone. This version uses matched AC128 germanium & 2N5087 silicon transistors. These are PNP transistors, but the pedal can be daisy chained with other standard 9V, negative-tip pedals. Because of the range of controls, this fuzz has both sweet & smooth tones & some wild untamed self-oscillating glitchy tones as well. There is a wide range here, and some very crazy settings.
